turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on linking sentences with and, but and because?
turns.tutor:
Hello! We use and to add an idea, but to show a different idea, and because to give a reason. Put a full stop at the end of each sentence. For example: It was cold at night, but the days were sunny.

Here is your exercise. Write 30-50 words about your last holiday. Use and, but and because.
